subset_selection.method: lowest SHA256(seed + NUL + task_id) among eligible uncontaminated IDs

source_policy.allowed: direct retrieval of exact atcoder.jp task URL only

arms.B0: current-session GPT-5.6 Sol solution from direct official public statement only
arms.B1: same frozen B0 plus minimum native verifier failure signal and at most one correction

rules: all three selected tasks stay in denominator
freeze B0 code before native verifier
one correction maximum per failed task
do not show hidden evaluator inputs/expected outputs to model
abort rather than repair contamination before B0
no capability-memory promotion from three-task smoke
